notes.title: Arcane Trigger Steam Next Fest Developer Livestreams Are Live!
notes.content:
New to the game? No worries! 
We're hosting continuous livestreams during Steam Next Fest to showcase Arcane Trigger's core gameplay styles.

[i][u][b]Join our community and share your thoughts![/b][/u][/i]
